units.source_text: 昨B扫除的时候，食指被扫帚的刺地扎伤，连这种小伤痛也成了我不安的缘由。

en.t: Yesterday, while sweeping at B, I pricked my index finger on a splinter from the broom, and even such a small hurt became a source of uneasiness for me.

units.source_text: 我想起了某诗人①被蔷薇花的刺儿扎伤竟成了死因的故事。

en.t: I remembered the story of a certain poet who was pricked by a rose thorn, and for whom that wound actually became the cause of death.

units.source_text: 当地的凡夫俗子只这一点是绝不会死去的。

en.t: The ordinary people of the place would certainly never die from that alone.

units.source_text: 但我已成为一个举足轻重的人，不知会招致怎样命运的死。

en.t: But I had already become a person of consequence, and I could not know what kind of fated death I might bring upon myself.

units.source_text: 指头的伤，多亏没有化脓，今天按了按伤口，只觉做做作痛。

en.t: Thanks to good fortune, the wound on my finger had not festered; when I pressed it today, it only throbbed faintly.
